headline: Tab leftovers: a clearer hide dialog, and a phone order that matches the wide strip
summary: The hide tabs dialog has a short placeholder in its search field, with the explanation sentence below the field. On a phone, the Pages sheet keeps each group in the same order as the wide strip. Menu actions in a section's tabs now save to that section, not to the main strip.
summary_yue: 隱藏分頁對話框嘅搜尋格而家有短嘅提示字，解釋嘅句子擺喺格下面。手機頁面表嘅分組次序而家同闊版分頁列一樣。分區分頁嘅選單動作會寫入嗰個分區，唔會寫去主分頁列。

highlights.title: Hide dialog hints, phone sheet order and section menu actions
highlights.what: The hide tabs dialog now has a short placeholder in its search field, and the sentence that explains it sits below the field, where it can wrap onto more lines. On a phone, the Pages sheet keeps each group where its first member sits, the same as the wide strip. The shared tab menu actions for hiding many tabs, undoing and removing from a group now save to the section they belong to, not to the main strip.
highlights.what_yue: 隱藏分頁對話框嘅搜尋格而家有短嘅提示字，解釋嘅句子擺喺格下面，長嘅句子可以自然換行。手機頁面表會將每個分組擺喺佢第一個分頁嗰個位，同闊版分頁列一樣。分區分頁嘅共用選單，批量隱藏、撤銷同移出分組，都會寫入嗰個分區，唔會寫去主分頁列。
highlights.why: The long sentence in the field was cut off when both languages were shown, and the phone order did not match the wide strip.
try: Open the hide dialog and read the short placeholder in the search field.
Read the sentence below the field.
Choose Phone sheet, then Wide strip, and check that the group order matches.
Tick Show the build before this fix to see the old order, then press Start again.
